claim: 定义：无政府主义是对权威与权力之正当性持怀疑论的政治理论，道德根基为免于支配的自由，正面理想为平等、共同体与非强制共识构建；条目自述以哲学无政府主义为主要描述对象。
locator: SEP《Anarchism》引言：'a political theory that is skeptical of the justification of authority and power'；'freedom from domination'；'equality, community, and non-coercive consensus building'；'This entry primarily describes "philosophical anarchism"'
note: 第一段定义与分层（哲学/政治无政府主义）均据此；西蒙斯弱承诺语见 §2（另条）。2026-10-05 curl 全文逐字再核。

claim: 词源：ἀν- + ἀρχή（反权威）；archē 兼有本原、根基、统治权力多义，anarchy 即无人统治/非统治。
locator: S1 §1.1：'arché, which means first principle, foundation, or ruling power. Anarchy is thus rule by no one or non-rule'；S2 开篇：'ANARCHISM (from the Gr. ἀν-, and ἀρχή, contrary to authority)'
note: 两个来源在词源上一致互补；『无政府』译名未覆盖『非统治』义为本包编辑判断，依据即此双义。

claim: 巴枯宁范式引语：有国家即有阶级支配与奴役，没有奴役的国家不可设想。
locator: S1 §1.1 引 Bakunin 1873 [1990: 178]：'If there is a State, there must be domination of one class by another and, as a result, slavery; the State without slavery is unthinkable—and this is why we are the enemies of the State.'
note: packet 顶部 quote 即此句的中译（标注转译）。

claim: 克鲁泡特金 1911 开篇的正面构想：社会无需政府，和谐靠各群体自由缔结的协议取得。
locator: S2 开篇：'harmony in such a society being obtained, not by submission to law, or by obedience to any authority, but by free agreements concluded between the various groups, territorial and professional…'
note: closingQuote 为此句的压缩转译，kind=paraphrase；完整原文录于本条 locator。

claim: 西蒙斯弱承诺立场：哲学无政府主义者不把国家不合法当作反对或消灭国家的强道德义务的根据。
locator: S1 §2 引 Simmons 2001: 104：'do not take the illegitimacy of states to entail a strong moral imperative to oppose or eliminate states'
note: 哲学/政治分层的关键文本。

claim: 霍布斯式挑战与无政府主义回应的结构：自然状态=『孤独、贫困、卑污、残忍而短寿』；无政府主义者回应国家自身制造压抑、暴力、腐败与不自由。
locator: S1 §2.1：'solitary, poor, nasty, brutish and short'；'Anarchists respond by claiming that the state tends to produce its own sort of unhappiness: as oppressive, violent, corrupt, and inimical to liberty'
note: 契约论对手论题（霍布斯、洛克、卢梭）与萨特维尔对罗尔斯原初状态的引申（Sartwell 2008: 83）同节。

claim: 蒲鲁东引语：人对人的政府是压迫，社会在秩序与无政府的结合中找到其最高完美。
locator: S1 §2.1 引 Proudhon 1840 [1876: 286]：'The government of man by man (under whatever name it be disguised) is oppression. Society finds its highest perfection in the union of order with anarchy.'
note: SEP 另记蒲鲁东所捍卫的『共产主义』以分散联合、公社与互助会为根基。

claim: 第一国际叙事：1864 年法国互助派工人与欧文派在伦敦创立；直接经济斗争路线沿至 1871；公社后分裂，拉丁系联邦与马克思主义总委员会完全决裂；『无政府主义者』之名最终被认领。
locator: S2 第一国际节：'revived only after 1864, when some French working men, all "mutualists," … founded the International Working Men's Association'；'this policy was followed until 1871'；'broke entirely with the Marxist general council'；'the name of "Anarchists," which their adversaries insisted upon applying to them, prevailed, and finally it was revindicated'
note: 另处记『自 1864–1866 年建立以来』——纪年微差已在时间线 1864 节点注。
uncertainty: 分裂的具体大会编年（海牙大会 1872 驱逐巴枯宁等）未核读，正文只写克鲁泡特金的叙述。

claim: 巴枯宁为拉丁系联邦发展无政府主义原则的主导精神；自名集体主义无政府主义者并给出界定；『只有当所有人都自由时……个人才真正自由』。
locator: S2 巴枯宁段：'soon became the leading spirit among these Latin federations'；'one becomes really free only when, and in proportion as, all others are free'；与 De Paepe、Guillaume、Schwitzguébel 自名 'Collectivist Anarchist' 及生产资料公有、报酬自定的界定
note: SEP §2.1 记巴枯宁、克鲁泡特金、戈德曼的无政府主义系作为对马克思与马克思主义的回应发展而成（overview 第三、四段用）。

claim: 克鲁泡特金引语与口号：『一切人为了一切人』、『福祉权』、『无政府引向共产主义，共产主义引向无政府……』；运动后期 chiefly 为无政府共产主义。
locator: S1 §2.4 引 Kropotkin 1892 [1995: 20]（Right to Well-Being）、[1995: 31]（'Anarchy leads to communism, and communism to anarchy…'）与 all for all；S2 发展段：'partly in the direction of Proudhonian "Mutuellisme," but chiefly as Communist-Anarchism'、自述段 'Communism and Anarchy are therefore two terms of evolution which complete each other'
note: chiefly 系 1911 年当事人判断，时代局限已在 conclusion 与 subSchools 注明。

claim: 个人无政府主义材料：施蒂纳『每个国家都是专制』与『被党拥抱』语；美国一线沃伦—斯普纳—塔克；塔克观念为蒲鲁东与斯宾塞之结合；克鲁泡特金对塔克『防卫』论的批评。
locator: S1 §2.4 引 Stirner 1844 [1995: 175]（'every state is a despotism'）、[1995: 211]（'embraced and taken up by the party'）；'Individualist anarchism has often been attributed to…Josiah Warren, Benjamin Tucker, and Thoreau'；S2 沃伦段（Time Store 1827、Cost—the limit of price）、塔克段（Liberty 1881、'combination of those of Proudhon with those of Herbert Spencer'、克鲁泡特金批评并标明系 present writer 意见）
note: overview 第五段与 thinkers 施蒂纳/塔克条、relations[3] 均据此。

claim: 戈德曼材料：sabotage 辩护引语；SEP 书目列《工团主义：其理论与实践》（1913）；克鲁泡特金记部分无政府共产主义者加入『所谓工团主义运动』并给出定义。
locator: S1 戈德曼节引 Goldman 1913 [1998: 94]（'it is ethical in the best sense…'）；S1 书目 Goldman 1913 [1996] 'Syndicalism: Its Theory and Practice'；S2：'have joined the so-called Syndicalist movement—the French name for the non-political Labour movement, devoted to direct struggle with capitalism'
note: 工团主义仅至此限度；CNT 等专门史实无已核来源（evidenceLimits 第 1 条）。
uncertainty: 无政府工团主义专门史实（CNT-FAI、西班牙内战）未核读。

claim: 罗特巴德建议以 non-archism 称其亲资本主义立场；布克钦批评生活风格化的个人无政府主义；费耶阿本德『科学在本质上是一项无政府的事业』为认识论立场。
locator: S1 §2.4：'libertarianism should be distinguished from anarchism by calling it "non-archism"'（Rothbard 2008）；'merely a matter of "lifestyle" (criticized in Bookchin 1995)'；S1 §1.3 引 Feyerabend 1975 [1993: 9]：'Science is an essentially anarchic enterprise…'；S3（备忘录 2026-10-04 核读）：《反对方法》副标题与 §5.2 标题
note: 词形辨析与归属分歧的来源基础。

claim: 沃尔夫论证的争论状态：Reiman 1972 批评其绝对/先验性质；萨特维尔论罗尔斯式缔约者未必不选无政府。
locator: S1 §2.2：'a point made by Reiman in his critique of Wolff (Reiman 1972)'；§2.1 引 Sartwell 2008: 83：'it is not clear that the contractors would not choose anarchy'
note: conclusion 第一段『论证无裁决』的依据。

claim: 暴力印象的证据结构与托名文献警示：公众印象出自镇压—报复循环并被支持者否认；托名巴枯宁的《革命问答》非其作品。
locator: S2 暴力段：'This created in the general public the impression that violence is the substance of Anarchism, a view repudiated by its supporters…'；脚注：'a philosophic Anarchist would repudiate the connexion'；书目按语：'The famous Revolutionary Catechism attributed to Bakunin, was not his work.'
note: conclusion 第二段与 politicalControversyNote 的直接依据。

claim: 戈德温：与洛克/霍布斯相反论证政府未必好于无政府；三则 1793 引语；克鲁泡特金『first to formulate』；结论本是共产主义、1796 第二版缓和。
locator: S1 §2.1：Godwin 1793: bk VII, chap. V, p. 736（'we must not hastily conclude…'）、bk III, chap. VII, p. 185–6（'government, even in its best state, is an evil…'）、'despotism is as perennial as anarchy is transitory'；S2 戈德温段：'the first to formulate the political and economical conceptions of Anarchism, even though he did not give that name'、'His conclusion was Communism'、第二版改写财产章
note: era 用文献锚定（1793/1796），生卒未核（evidenceLimits 第 3 条）。

claim: 蒲鲁东：1840 首先自名 Anarchy；『财产即偷窃』及其罗马法限定；互助主义（互助银行/劳动券/成本价）；拒共产主义兵营方案与国家社会主义。
locator: S2 蒲鲁东段：'the first to use, in 1840 (Qu'est-ce que la propriété? first memoir), the name of Anarchy…'、'Property is theft' 限定（Roman-law sense of 'right of use and abuse'）、Mutuellisme 与劳动券、约 1% 管理费、'社会清算'；S2 书目：1840/1846/1849/1851 四种著作、英译者 B. Tucker；S1 §2.1 引 1840 [1876: 286]
note: works[1]、cihai[2]、relations[0][1][3] 据此。

claim: 巴枯宁：国家/奴役语（1873）与废神语（1882）；彻底废国家、拒一切立法、公社自治；集体主义自名与界定。
locator: S1 §1.1 引 Bakunin 1873 [1990: 178]；§1.2 引 1882 [1970: 28]（'if God really existed, it would be necessary to abolish him'）；S1 书目 Bakunin 1873 [1990] Statism and Anarchy；S2 巴枯宁段（leading spirit、真自由语、Collectivist Anarchist 界定）
note: works[2] 书目年份 1873 据此。

claim: 克鲁泡特金：无政府共产主义两极命题与口号；《互助论》主旨；1910/1911 百科条目署名 P. A. K. 并为运动一方原典。
locator: S1 §2.4 引 1892 [1995: 20、31]；S2 自述段：'As one of the Anarchist-Communist direction, the present writer…'、'two terms of evolution which complete each other'、'the part played in history by the popular constructive agencies of mutual aid'；S2 开篇与暴力段；S1 书目 Kropotkin 1910 'Anarchism'（1910 edition）；S4 版本页题注 (1902)
note: 《互助论》《面包与自由》正文未直读，works[4][5] 只写定位与主旨。
uncertainty: 克鲁泡特金条目年份 1910（S1 书目）与 1911（Wikisource 版）两说并存。

claim: 施蒂纳：本名 Kaspar Schmidt；『每个国家都是专制』；不可被党『拥抱和吞没』；诸我的联合；书长期被忽视后经麦凯表彰。
locator: S1 §2.4 引 Stirner 1844 [1995: 175、211]；S2 施蒂纳段：'its fullest expression in Max Stirner (Kaspar Schmidt)'、Der Einzige und sein Eigenthum、'the association of the egotists'、Mackay 表彰
note: 纪年 1844（SEP）vs 1845（S2 书目）两说并存，works[3] 并注。

claim: 塔克：《自由》1881 年创办；观念为蒲鲁东与斯宾塞的结合；经济学承蒲鲁东；克鲁泡特金批评其『防卫』论。
locator: S2 塔克段：'whose journal Liberty was started in 1881 and whose conceptions are a combination of those of Proudhon with those of Herbert Spencer'、'As regards his economical views B. R. Tucker follows Proudhon'、克鲁泡特金以 present writer 意见批评『防卫』重建国家职能；S1 §2.4 并列 Warren/Tucker/Thoreau
note: S2 正文 1881 与文末书目'1892 sqq.'不一致，works[7] 从正文并注。

claim: 托尔斯泰：克鲁泡特金记其加入基督教无政府主义方向；SEP 记不服从义务（Tolstoy 1894）与和平主义。
locator: S2 发展段：'a third direction, Christian-Anarchism, was added by Leo Tolstoy'；S1 §1.2：'Tolstoy claims that Christians have a duty not to obey political power and to refuse to swear allegiance…'（see Tolstoy 1894）、'Tolstoy was also a pacifist'、Tolstoy-Gandhi-King 传统；S1 书目 Tolstoy 1894 The Kingdom of God is Within You（London: William Heinemann）

claim: 沃尔夫：正当权威=命令与服从之权利；自主论证推出『de jure 正当国家概念空洞』（1970: 17）；承认 de facto 合法性；Reiman 1972 批评。
locator: S1 §2.2：Wolff 1970: 16（'he will never view the commands of the state as legitimate…'）、1970: 17（'the concept of a de jure legitimate state would appear to be vacuous…'）、1970: 55（unanimous direct democracy 不可能落地）、Reiman 1972、de facto/de jure 之分
note: 引文均经 SEP 转引；Wolff 原书未直读（evidenceLimits 第 4 条）。

claim: 戈德温→蒲鲁东为『两个第一』的编辑比较：first to formulate（1793，未命名）与 first to use the name（1840）是两个不同断言；直接影响无据。
locator: S2 戈德温段与蒲鲁东段（见 thinkers/0、thinkers/1 locator）
note: 关系类型标为编辑比较（先后承接待核），不写师承。

claim: 蒲鲁东→巴枯宁：第一国际创建者『全是互助派』；分裂后巴枯宁为联邦派主导精神；学说分歧（互助占有 vs 集体公有）有明文。
locator: S2 第一国际节（'all "mutualists"'）与巴枯宁段（'leading spirit'）、巴枯宁经济观段（Collectivist Anarchist 界定）
note: 两人是否直接相识无据，关系以组织为中介。

claim: 巴枯宁→克鲁泡特金：无政府共产主义『从国际的无政府主义集体主义中逐渐演化而来』；克鲁泡特金自认该方向一员；SEP 不以师承表述。
locator: S2 无政府共产主义名单段：'have gradually evolved out of the Anarchist Collectivism of the International Working Men's Association'；S2 自述段：'As one of the Anarchist-Communist direction, the present writer…'；S1 §2.1 三人并举为对马克思的回应
note: 关系类型标为接受（运动谱系的自我叙述）。

claim: 蒲鲁东→塔克：《自由》观念=蒲鲁东+斯宾塞；经济学承蒲鲁东；美国蒲鲁东派学派（含沃伦相应构想、斯普纳等）。
locator: S2 塔克段与美国学派段（'French mutualism had its precursor…'、'found a considerable following in the United States, creating quite a school'）

claim: 沃尔夫→戈德温：否认国家正当性的两种做法（正面方案 vs 哲学立场），编辑比较，无阅读关系证据。
locator: S2 戈德温段（小而完全自治的公社即可无政府存在）；S1 §2.2 与 §2 弱承诺分层

claim: 1793：戈德温《政治正义论》两卷本出版（伦敦 G. G. J. and J. Robinson）；1796 第二版改写财产章。
locator: S1 书目 Godwin 1793 条目；S2 戈德温段（'Enquiry concerning Political Justice (2 vols., 1793)'、第二版 1796）

claim: 1840：蒲鲁东《什么是所有权？》首篇论文，『无政府主义』得名；『财产即偷窃』。
locator: S2 蒲鲁东段与书目（'Qu'est-ce que la propriété? 1er mémoire (1840) (Eng. trans. by B. Tucker)'）；S1 §2.1 引 1840 [1876: 286]

claim: 1864：第一国际创立于伦敦，创建者法国工人『全是互助派』。
locator: S2：'revived only after 1864…founded the International Working Men's Association'；另处 'since the foundation of the International Working Men's Association in 1864–1866'

claim: 1872（前后）：联邦派与马克思主义总委员会完全决裂；『无政府主义者』之名被认领；年份锚定为汝拉《公报》1872—1879 与『1871 年后很快分裂』的叙述。
locator: S2 第一国际节（'this policy was followed until 1871'、'broke entirely with the Marxist general council'、'finally it was revindicated'）；S2 书目 'Bulletin de la fédération jurassienne (1872–1879)'
note: 海牙大会等大会编年未核读，不写。

locator: S2：'the execution of five Chicago Anarchists in 1887'与暴力段；S1 §2：'The popular imagination often views anarchists as bomb-throwing nihilists'

claim: 1892：《面包与自由》——福祉权、一切人为一切人、两极命题。
locator: S1 书目 Kropotkin 1892 [1995] The Conquest of Bread（La Conquête du Pain）及 §2.4 引 20、31 页；S2 自编书目 'Conquest of Bread (1906) (1st French ed. in 1890)'
note: 纪年差异（1892 vs 自记 1906/1890）已并注，从 S1。

claim: 1910/1911：克鲁泡特金《大英百科》条目；SEP 书目记 1910 edition，Wikisource 置于第 11 版卷 1；署名 P. A. K.。
locator: S1 书目：'Kropotkin, Peter, 1910, "Anarchism", in The Encyclopaedia Britannica, 1910 edition'；S2 页面属 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica 卷 1；S2 页内署名（备忘录 2026-10-04 记 '条目署名 P. A. K.'，本轮页面 grep 复核作者缩写语境一致）
uncertainty: 条目年份 1910/1911 两说，节点并注。

claim: 1970：沃尔夫《为无政府主义辩护》；Reiman 1972 即有批评；诺齐克（S1 记 1974）从同一出发点走向反面。
locator: S1 §2.2（Wolff 1970 及 Reiman 1972）；§2.1（Nozick's Anarchy, State, Utopia (1974) 与 invisible hand 论证）
note: 诺齐克年份归政治哲学包核录。

claim: 1975：费耶阿本德《反对方法》与理论无政府主义——词形边界节点。
locator: S1 §1.3 引 Feyerabend 1975 [1993: 9]：'Science is an essentially anarchic enterprise: theoretical anarchism is more humanitarian and more likely to encourage progress than its law-and-order alternatives.'；S3（备忘录核读）：副标题 'Outline of an Anarchist Theory of Knowledge'、§5.2 标题
note: S3 为 2026-10-04 备忘录实读记录，本日未重读。

claim: 词目『无政府主义』：定义与词源（archē 多义、anarchy=非统治；安那其主义异译）。
locator: S1 引言与 §1.1；S2 开篇（ἀν- + ἀρχή, contrary to authority）
note: 『安那其主义』为民国文献及学术史异译，系任务备忘录既有记录，非来源正文断言。

claim: 词目『互助』：克鲁泡特金视为历史进化的民众建构性力量。
locator: S2 自述段：'analysed the part played in history by the popular constructive agencies of mutual aid and the historical rôle of the state'；S4 版本页（年份）
